answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 9208 Country: Pakistan Title: What is difference between Hajj and Hajj-e-Akbar? Question: What is difference between Hajj and Hajj-e-Akbar? Answer ID: 9208 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1202/1202=M/1429) It is famous among people that a hajj occurring on Friday is Hajj-e-Akbar, but it is not proved from any Fiqh books and mujtahid imams. However, the Fiqh and Hadith books state that hajj is hajj-e-akbar (big hajj) while umrah is hajj-e-asghar (small hajj). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
